name: BufferLinkPreviewBot
description: The crawler behind link previews in Buffer's social-media management product. When someone shares a link in Buffer it fetches the page's public metadata — title, description, thumbnail and Open Graph or Twitter Card data — so the poster can see how the post will look. Buffer publishes its egress addresses both on that page and as a machine-readable JSON document, and sends X-BufferLinkPreviewBot headers alongside the user agent.
